mapper.select: SELECT contract_id AS id, contract_name AS title, contract_no AS number, status, dept_id AS scope_dept_id, owner_id AS scope_owner_id FROM oa_contract WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND (contract_name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR contract_no LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!')

SELECT asset_id AS id, name AS title, asset_code AS number, status FROM oa_asset WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND (name LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR asset_code LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!')
